item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: In short terms: No data is collected.

POI Toolbox, chdv and mtu do not collect any personal data.
Your own location is only used in POI Toolbox to display it on the map or to record a GPX file on your behalf. On pause the GPS tracker saves its work data only locally - on the user's device. There is no automatic cloud upload (which could otherwise expose start/end positions). In other words: "If you reset the tracker without saving your track, it is gone. Gone really means gone."
POI Toolbox, chdv and mtu also do not share any data with any services. There is no attempt to track or monitor the user in any way, neither by ad-trackers, nor with black magic.
Other entered data (POIs, folders, tracker logs, names, ...) is stored in non-encrypted files, which you can find in a subfolder in your iCloud drive documents. You can always make a backup, restore a backup, copy them and import them into another application...
WARNING: However, do not modify these files if you are just a little uncertain whether you are doing everything right or have understood the file format perfectly! Even a very simple typo in these files can lead to complete data loss.
Again: "Gone means gone."
This web page sets no cookies, so it doesn't need a cookie banner.
